extracted.name: Jalapeño Chicken Dip
extracted.description: This jalapeño chicken dip is so easy. Everyone will be asking you for the recipe. You can make it as spicy or mild as you want.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) can chunk white chicken in water, thoroughly drained
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Combine chicken and seasoned salt in a large skillet over medium-low heat; heat through.

Combine cream cheese and condensed soup in a microwave-safe bowl; cover and heat for 1 minute in the microwave. Add chicken mixture and continue to heat at 1-minute intervals until the liquid bubbles. Stir in jalapeños and serve immediately.
